description_excerpt: About The Role The Senior Compliance Executive plays a vital role in upholding company's governance standards by supporting the implementation and ongoing management of the organization's Compliance Program. Working closely with the Compliance Manager, this role contributes to a culture of integrity by ensuring business operations align with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and industry best practices. What You Will Deliver • Support the implementation and maintenance of the Compliance Program, ensuring robust governance frameworks are consistently applied across the organization.…
